summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running anything (read-only verification; rich is not installed here). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs; UnderlineBar in src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py gained clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity in src/textual/renderables/opacity.py now merges the blend onto each segment's existing style so click metadata is preserved; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and new tests/test_tabs.py. Decisions to review: the bar position uses the displayed-tab index rather than the full-list find_tab_by_name index, so duplicate names still underline the displayed tab (acceptance criterion 11); the layout resolver was left unchanged because its edge already had size, min_size, and fraction defaults; a zero-width label is treated as flexible by the resolver, a known edge case I did not change to preserve existing callers; the optional sandbox demo was skipped. Nothing has been run, so the new tests are unverified.
